first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A large mounted double-barreled firearm in the foreground, with a box-shaped gun body, curved tube belts, and a support underneath; most of it is occluded by the person operating it in the initial frame.

entities.name: Snow-Covered Rocky Battlefield
entities.identification: An undulating surface in the middle and lower portions, composed of fractured rock platforms, dark exposed rock, and discontinuous light-colored snow cover.

entities.name: Upper Smoke-Cloud Background
entities.identification: The upper background region corresponding to the original "smoke-cloud sky"; initially covered by intense white-yellow light and orange-brown smoke-dust, with a dark blue-gray base color partially revealed in the final segment.

entities.name: Explosion and Smoke-Dust
entities.identification: The intense white-yellow light, billowing smoke-dust, and scattering debris in the center and subsequently on the image-right, as well as the more distant bright explosion area on the left in the final segment.

entities.name: Red-Glowing Mechanical Group
entities.identification: A group of mechanical humanoids in the middle distance; in the final frame, at least one dark humanoid on the left and a red glowing point on its upper body are discernible.

entities.name: Red Glowing Projectile Trajectory
entities.identification: A collection of red or red-white linear light trails that traverse the battlefield one after another, some with a visible dark projectile at the leading end.
